'''Bassa Bridge''' was a man-made bridge constructed by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] as a crossing point of one of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River's]] many tributaries.

==History==
Built early on in [[Theed/Legends|Theed's]] history, Bassa Bridge was located downstream of the falls that crested over the cliffs of Theed. One of the primary crossings of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] in the city, the bridge became decrepit over its several hundred [[Standard year/Legends|year]] history and was so weakened that [[Pergola's Bridge/Legends|Pergola's Bridge]] was erected upstream to relieve the strain on the older crossing.<ref name="SWCL" />
